description:
Program Overview

The CDT-D2AIR is a 4-year PhD programme jointly offered by Heriot-Watt University and the University of Edinburgh, focusing on developing dependable and deployable AI for robotics. This centre is funded by UKRI (UK Research and Innovation) and represents a substantial investment in robotics research.

Funding & Benefits

  • Tuition Fees: Full coverage (UK/EU and international rates) for 4 years
  • Stipend: £18,622 per year (2026/27 rate, tax-free) for 4 years
  • Research Training Support Grant: £5,000 per year for conference travel, equipment
  • Industry Engagement: Placements and collaborations with industry partners
  • Total Value: Approximately £90,000 - £120,000 (depending on fee status)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Academic Requirements: First-class or upper second-class honours degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, or related field
  • Nationality: Open to UK, EU, and international students
  • Research Interest: Focus on AI, robotics, verification, or autonomous systems
  • English Language: Standard university requirements (IELTS 6.5+ or equivalent)

Application Process

  1. Identify supervisor and develop proposal.
  2. Submit application to university.
  3. Shortlisting process.
  4. Interview with selection panel.
  5. Funding decision.
  6. Scholarship award.

Key Research Areas

  • Autonomous Systems: Self-driving vehicles, drones, and underwater robots
  • Robotics Verification: Formal methods for ensuring safety in robotic systems
  • Human-Robot Interaction: Safe collaboration between humans and robots
  • Field Robotics: Robots for agriculture, construction, and inspection
  • Robot Learning: Machine learning for robotic perception and control

Timeline & Deadlines

Application OpensSeptember 2026
Scholarship Deadline14 November 2026
Interview PeriodDecember 2026 - January 2027
Award NotificationFebruary 2027
Program StartSeptember 2027

Official Link

https://cdt-d2air.ac.uk/

Important Notes

  • research on safe and reliable robotics for real-world applications.
  • Access to facilities and expertise at both Heriot-Watt and Edinburgh.
  • Industry connections with companies like Amazon, Jaguar Land Rover, and NASA.
  • Prepare for both academic and industrial research careers.
